title: United States labor & social structures (recent official figures)
description: Recent, dated, sourced social/labor statistics for the United States, held as Structures. These are real published figures, not placeholders. Discipline: these are OBSERVED published statistics; any relation drawn between them is a MODEL, not a causal claim.

provenance.note: Each structure carries its own source and period. ASSOCIATION != CAUSATION. Structures are alphabetized by name for reader ease.
